title: iberis intermedia subsp. boppardensis
intro: Iberis intermedia subsp. boppardensis, commonly known as rockcress or sweet rocket, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Iberis intermedia subsp. boppardensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and bronchodilatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of bronchitis, asthma, and other respiratory disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
